title: Full system crash when android export is present (on Ubuntu)
body:
### Tested versions

Godot 4.5.1 ,  4.4.1

-different godot builds
-custom build
-regular/mono

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable.mono unknown - Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 (nvidia; 580.95.05) - AMD Ryzen 9 7950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.53 GiB memory

### Issue description

It toke me DAYS to figure out whats causing this ...
After opening one of my projects, after about 20-40 sec  PC just dies instantly and starts again after few sec (like instant power cut)
Project is very simple, pure 2d.

I tried everything:
-different drivers
-setting much lower wattage for gpu
-different godot builds
-custom build
-regular/mono
-deleting cache,
-vulkan/opengl
nothing worked...  and it was just with this one project, so i started to look for specifics related to just this one ..

It turns out that JUST by having Android export  present in "export" menu it causes this crash.
I also have Windows and Linux exports, they work fine and not causing any problems. But moment i go to "add" and make Android export , it will crash after 10-20-30 sec. So im not even running the game, nothing , just add preset and wait for it to happen.

This definitely does not happen on Windows.
